description_en: Create a container reservation job. The reservation can run containers that support a specified number of sessions, and the reservation result is returned via an HTTP API
description_zh: 创建容器预定任务。预定可运行指定会话数量的容器，预定结果通过HTTP接口返回
kebab_example: aliyun cgcs create-capacity-reservation --project-id d9a80000 --app-id 130270000 --app-version 350670000 --district-id huadong --expect-resource-ready-time 2022-02-02_22:22:22 --expect-session-capacity 100 --client-token 2YEF00000 --region cn-hangzhou
